verdict.rationale: Exporting your own records in open formats is a fair question for a state business-filing portal, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only robots.txt probes that met bot walls on www.nvsos.gov and esos.nv.gov/orion.nv.gov. It says nothing about any data-export capability, open export formats or account portability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
